# Line Art Animation Skill

Curated by Skill Harbor: Build animated line-art components in SVG and TypeScript, thin ink lines on paper where people and animals walk, run, cycle and react, with wind, lit windows and a day/night cycle, exportable to video when you need it.

Its guide pins the look first, pen weight, paper colour, figure proportions and one or two flat accent colours, then builds one figure or one corner and shows it before the rest. Motion comes from gait, spring and pendulum helpers, clothes drawn around the skeleton so cloth opens and closes with the stride, and feet kept planted on the ground. Scenes are self-contained cards on a fixed page background, with a time-of-day palette, lights, wind and people arriving on schedules. It also covers matching a reference clip and capturing deterministic video frames. You need Node 22.18 or newer, Vite and TypeScript, ffmpeg and a local Chrome or Chromium for video capture. By @JDhruv14, listed here with credit to its creator. Discovered via GitHub. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
